tests.name: T1205.002 - Add Custom Firewall Rule for Traffic Signaling Simulation
tests.description: Simulates an adversary creating a custom inbound firewall rule designed to act as a traffic signaling trigger for backdoor activation.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Register Custom WinSock Protocol Catalog Entry
tests.description: Simulates an adversary modifying WinSock protocol catalogs (`Protocol_Catalog9`) to register a custom packet interception provider.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Register Custom WinSock Name Space Provider (NSP) Stub
tests.description: Simulates an adversary adding a custom WinSock Name Space Provider to intercept name resolution and socket binding requests.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Simulate Packet Capture Driver Service Registration
tests.description: Simulates an adversary registering a rogue kernel-level packet capture driver service to intercept raw network traffic.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Register Custom WFP Callout Provider Registry Key
tests.description: Simulates an adversary registering a Windows Filtering Platform callout provider registry configuration to hook deep packet inspection points.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Modify TCPIP Parameter Registry for Raw Socket Behavior
tests.description: Simulates adversary adjustment of network stack registry configurations to alter raw socket handling and packet inspection thresholds.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Register Winsock Transport Filter Layer Provider
tests.description: Simulates adversary registration of a Winsock Layered Service Provider (LSP) or transport filter key in the networking stack.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Inject Simulated Socket Filter Helper Key in NetworkStack
tests.description: Simulates an adversary injecting network stack helper configuration keys to monitor raw socket states for trigger packets.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Register Custom WFP Sublayer Registry Key
tests.description: Simulates an adversary creating a custom WFP sublayer registry configuration to manage high-priority packet filtering rules.

tests.name: T1205.002 - Create Raw Socket Binding Persistence Hook Registry
tests.description: Simulates an adversary adding a networking hook parameter registry entry to initialize custom socket filter hooks at system startup.
